input.summary: Cap Customer-payable termination fee at three months' fees, replace the Termination for Cause Fee with that same early-termination fee, and make it the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our preferred position is that Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties; as a fallback we accept a single early-termination fee capped at three months' fees. We therefore cap the Termination for Convenience Fee at three months' average Fees, replace the separate Termination for Cause Fee (a percentage of Estimated Remaining Value) with that same early-termination fee, and confirm in § 13.5 that it is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.

ops.oldText: Customer may terminate this Agreement during the Term upon at least one (1) years' written notice to M&I, provided that Customer pays M&I an early termination fee ("Termination for Convenience Fee") in an amount equal to REDACTED of the Estimated Remaining Value.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement during the Term upon at least one (1) years' written notice to M&I, provided that Customer pays M&I an early termination fee ("Termination for Convenience Fee") in an amount equal to three (3) times the average monthly Fees payable by Customer during the three (3) months prior to the Effective Date of Termination.

ops.oldText: then Customer shall pay M&I a termination fee ("Termination for Cause Fee") in an amount equal to REDACTED of the Estimated Remaining Value, payable as set forth in Section 11.1 above. In addition to the foregoing, Customer shall pay to M&I, reasonable Expenses in connection with the disposition of equipment, facilities and contracts related to M&I's performance of the Services on behalf of Customer. The Termination for Cause Fee shall not be subject to the limitations set forth in Section 13.4.
ops.newText: then Customer shall pay M&I the Termination for Convenience Fee determined and payable as set forth in Section 11.1 above, and no other termination fee, liquidated damages or penalty. In addition to the foregoing, Customer shall pay to M&I, reasonable Expenses in connection with the disposition of equipment, facilities and contracts related to M&I's performance of the Services on behalf of Customer.

ops.oldText: Customer acknowledges that the Termination for Convenience Fee and the Termination for Cause Fee are each a reasonable approximation of such damages and shall be deemed to be liquidated damages and not a penalty.
ops.newText: Customer acknowledges that the Termination for Convenience Fee is a reasonable approximation of such damages and shall be deemed to be liquidated damages and not a penalty. The Termination for Convenience Fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement.
